items.title: Antonelli wins in Austin from pole
items.summary: Antonelli took pole on medium tyres, got away well and built a lead over Verstappen, then won comfortably on a one-stop strategy. Leclerc finished second. Lawson was ninth after qualifying as best of the rest.
items.why_it_matters: The win left the title open mathematically, with Hamilton and Russell still in contention.

items.title: Verstappen and Hadjar criticise Red Bull's execution
items.summary: The Race reports that both drivers complained about avoidable problems, including poor getaways and radio problems, that stopped them capitalising on their car's potential.
items.why_it_matters: This is the drivers' account as reported by one outlet; do not present it as a team finding.

sources.label: The Race: Verstappen and Hadjar furious

items.title: Ferrari's Austin upgrade targets rear downforce
items.summary: Formula1.com says Ferrari changed the floor body, floorboards, sidepod/undercut and diffuser. The aim was more rear downforce, though Ferrari also claim added front-floor load. The Race argues Austin showed where Ferrari still lacks.
items.why_it_matters: Separate Ferrari's claims from measured performance; Leclerc still said the team came short of winning.
